integrity: Signed chain/matching formulae and exact Smith invariants are reproducible by verify.py using the listed open-source integer-arithmetic dependency. Computations provide a finite proof for each enumerated graph and are not used to extrapolate to larger n.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification only for n=2..7; n>=8 not covered. Ordinary, not equivariant, homotopy. Independent external mathematical audit not performed. An unindexed equivalent calculation is possible.
title: First mixed-dimensional homotopy in three-clique-free triangular graphs
